title: A monic polynomial has a finite free splitting extension
statement: Let $A$ be a nonzero commutative ring and $P\in A[T]$ a monic polynomial (leading coefficient $1$) [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. There exist a nonzero commutative $A$-algebra $S$, finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] as an $A$-module, such that the coefficient image of $P$ in $S[T]$ is a product of monic linear polynomials $T-\alpha$, with $\alpha\in S$. The empty product is allowed.
